sentences.text:
The Court made the following:
 2  ORDER

This Writ Petition is filed seeking to declare the action of 3rd respondent police in calling the petitioners 1 to 3 and their family members to the police station and the respondent-police not following the procedure contemplated in Arnesh Kumar Vs. State of Bihar and also Lalita Kumari Vs. Government of U.P. & Ors. by issuing notice Section 41-A Cr.P.C. as illegal and arbitrary, and direct the respondents not to interfere with the personal liberty in the matrimonial affairs of 1st petitioner in connection with pending O.P.No.163 of 2024 before the II Additional Family Court,
Hyderabad, Telangana.
2. Grievance of the petitioners is that 4th respondent, who is wife of 1st petitioner, gave complaint against the petitioners and 3rd respondent-police threatening them to come to police station and the police visited the house of the petitioners and created panic situation in their mind.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The complaint was given only with an intention to squeeze money from them and the police are trying to arrest the petitioners without following the guidelines prescribed by the Hon'ble Supreme Court.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioners, after arguing for some time, has confined his argument to the extent of protecting the petitioners from the coercive action by the police in Crime No.106 of 2024 of Chebrolu PS, Eluru District registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498A and 506 IPC on the ground that the offences alleged are punishable with imprisonment of less than 7 years and prays this Court to direct the police to follow the procedure as contemplated under Section 41A of Cr.P.C.
4.

On the other hand, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor did not oppose the same and concurred with the submission made by the learned counsel for the petitioners for the reason that the offences alleged are punishable with imprisonment of less than seven years.

5. Heard. Perused the material on record.
6.

Since the allegations leveled against the petitioners are punishable with imprisonment of less than seven years, this Court directs the police to follow the procedure as contemplated under Section 41A of Cr.P.C. scrupulously as per the guidelines enunciated in Arnesh Kumar Vs. State of Bihar and another1.
7.
